runtime.rs::LISTENER_SERIAL.reason: Independent per-thread counts of listener entries and trapped listeners. Scoped engine leases compare the entry count; owning decide/fire/apply actions compare the trap count to decide whether to abort tentative Host writes.

runtime.rs::MODS.reason: Dependency-ordered hook routing and its per-mod enabled bits remain engine-owned.

runtime.rs::MODS_SWITCHED.reason: Counts changes to the per-mod enabled bits it sits beside; read through the host's capability provider table, never by a guest's own copy.

runtime.rs::TEST_MODS.reason: Thread-local dispatch inventory for isolated engine tests.

wire/static_strings.rs::intern::STRINGS.reason: Bounded interning for decoded static strings; entries are immutable, shared by value, and never evicted.

world/phase_refusal.rs::SCOPE.reason: Per-thread record of the mod and hook whose listener call is in flight and whether a refusal has latched, which the gate reads to contain a wrong-phase Host call.

world/phase_refusal.rs::report::LOGGED.reason: Process-wide set of the (mod, operation) pairs whose refusal has been logged, so a refusing hook names the operation once and not on every call.
